I said "side of hotel" again, and the app let me finish without trying "I do not sleep". Also Mina asked about the breakfast room in "my hotel", which is strange when I am the guest. For the desk tomorrow I want phrases for the receptionist side, not the guest side. Nothing here worries me for Tomáš and Klára, which is important. I would use it again for fifteen minutes in the evening, and I would tell a colleague, but the replay needs to be better.
